# SolarMatch — Go Solar, Get Matched

> AI-powered rooftop solar feasibility platform for Egypt. SolarMatch combines NASA POWER climate data, Google Solar API rooftop analysis, real 2026 EgyptERA tariffs, and AI verification to estimate solar system size, production, savings, payback and CO₂ reduction for homes, farms, and businesses — in Arabic and English.

Site: https://solarmatch.site
Languages: Arabic (ar-EG), English (en-US)
Geography: Egypt (residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural)

## What SolarMatch Does
- Free solar feasibility study (2-minute analysis)
- System sizing (kWp) based on rooftop area + monthly consumption
- Cost, ROI, payback, and 25-year savings projection
- Connection-type recommendation: on-grid / hybrid / off-grid
- Bilingual PDF report
- Verified by AI checkpoint (capped financial adjustments)

- /solar/{governorate}            Solar feasibility per Egyptian governorate (27 governorates)

All hubs available in both /en and /ar.

## Data Sources
- NASA POWER (solar irradiance, temperature, climate)
- Google Solar API (rooftop segment analysis)
- Google Maps + Places (location, geometry)
- EgyptERA 2026 tariffs (residential 7-tier, commercial 6-tier, industrial 5-tier)
- Firecrawl-cached live market prices (24h)
- Lovable AI Gateway (Gemini 2.5) for AI verification and chatbot

## Authoritative Facts About Egypt Solar (2026)
- Average irradiance: 5.5–7.0 kWh/m²/day (one of the highest globally)
- Residential payback: 4–7 years for grid-connected systems
- Net metering: available under EgyptERA regulations
- Khamaseen dust season (Mar–May): 4–8% efficiency loss; cleaning recommended
- Typical 5 kWp residential turnkey cost (2026): ~110,000 EGP
- Grid CO₂ factor: 0.45 kg/kWh
